Looking at the screenshot, I can see three overlapping dark rectangular bands covering items 10-17 in the navigation list. These correspond to the three div elements at the end of the DOM tree: `root>alpha`, `root>beta`, and `root>gamma`.

In CSS, when elements overlap without explicit z-index values, they are painted in DOM order - later elements appear on top of earlier ones. Since these three divs appear in the order alpha, beta, gamma in the DOM tree, `gamma` would be painted last and therefore appear on top at the overlap point.

ANSWER: root>gamma
